# Daryaft pull request

## Problem

Explain the user-visible problem.

## Summary

Describe the smallest complete change.

## Related issue

Link the actual issue. Do not use a local draft ID as a GitHub issue number.

## Design decisions

Link relevant ADRs and describe trade-offs.

## Tests performed

Record commands and observed results.

## Verification steps

Describe acceptance evidence and independent review.

## Security and limitations

Describe access-control effects, unverified behavior, and risks.

## Documentation changes

Link the updated documents.
